label: CDP
notes: Cisco Discovery Protocol over Ethernet, EtherType 0x2000 (Cisco proprietary; the normative reference is the Cisco Discovery Protocol Specification). The 4-byte header (version, TTL, checksum) is modelled in full. Everything after it is a TLV chain whose offsets shift with each TLV's length, so no TLV payload sits at a fixed offset. CDPv2 sends to 01:00:0c:cc:cc:cc with version 2; CDPv1 packets differ only in the version byte. LLDP (IEEE 802.1AB) is the standards-based counterpart and a separate entry.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: CDP version; 2 on current Cisco devices.

fields.label: TTL
fields.description: Seconds a receiver should hold the neighbour information; 180 by default.
